# Stadt Land Fluss

> Real-time multiplayer version of the classic game "Stadt Land Fluss" in the
> browser. Create a lobby or join via a 6-character code or QR code and play
> together in real time, server-authoritative and without any sign-up.

The game runs entirely in the browser (React SPA) against a Go WebSocket backend.
The server is the single source of truth for rules, scoring and game state.
There are no public API endpoints for agents; the game is operated interactively
through the web interface.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Create a lobby or join an existing one.
- [Join by code](/join/CODE): Direct link into a lobby (CODE = 6-character lobby code).

## Flow

- Create a lobby and invite other players via code or QR code.
- Set the categories and number of rounds, then play rounds that share a letter.
- Answers are reviewed after each round; the game ends with a ranking.
